title: terminal
description: Live geopolitical and markets intelligence wire: 35k+ wire items, event threads, 55k+ articles.
summary: Live geopolitical and markets intelligence wire: 35k+ wire items, event threads, 55k+ articles.
offersHint: Live geopolitical and markets intelligence wire: 35k+ wire items, event threads, 55k+ articles. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://terminal.themonexus.com/mcp · Optional headers: X-API-Key

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Monexus Terminal API key. Minted by a 30-day pass (GET https://terminal.themonexus.com/api/v1/pass?tier=wire|desk|bureau via x402, or card at /api/v1/pass/payfast) or a membership (/api/v1/member/subscribe). Optional: without it, paid tools return structured x402 payment guidance and the free list_categories tool still works.

headerDocs.name: X-API-Key
headerDocs.description: Monexus Terminal API key. Minted by a 30-day pass (GET https://terminal.themonexus.com/api/v1/pass?tier=wire|desk|bureau via x402, or card at /api/v1/pass/payfast) or a membership (/api/v1/member/subscribe). Optional: without it, paid tools return structured x402 payment guidance and the free list_categories tool still works.

toolsPreview.name: search_wire
toolsPreview.description:
Latest Monexus Terminal wire items (paid, $0.001/req or pass).

    Args:
        category: optional beat filter, e.g. geopolitics, business, tech, crypto, sports, science.
        query: optional full-text search string.
        limit: max items to return (1-100).

toolsPreview.name: list_threads
toolsPreview.description: Live event threads: wire items clustered into developing stories (paid, $0.002/req or pass).

toolsPreview.name: get_thread
toolsPreview.description:
One event thread with all of its wire items (paid, $0.002/req or pass).

    Args:
        thread_id: the thread id, as returned by list_threads or search_wire.

toolsPreview.name: get_context
toolsPreview.description:
Full context brief for a thread: background, timeline and significance (paid, $0.005/req or pass).

    Args:
        item_id: the thread/item id to build the context brief for.

toolsPreview.name: list_articles
toolsPreview.description:
Index of 55,000+ licensed Monexus articles (paid, $0.002/req or pass).

    Args:
        category: optional category filter.
        limit: max articles to return.
        before: pagination cursor, return articles published before this timestamp/id.

toolsPreview.name: get_article
toolsPreview.description:
One full licensed Monexus article as markdown plus metadata (paid, $0.01/req or pass).

    Args:
        slug: the article slug from list_articles.

toolsPreview.name: deals
toolsPreview.description:
Live in-date SADC deals from the PriceMate catalogue corpus (paid, $0.003/req or pass).

    Real retail prices across Botswana, Lesotho, Mozambique, Namibia and South Africa:
    microwaves, phones, appliances, groceries. Prices in local currency per retailer.

    Args:
        category: optional category filter (e.g. Electronics, Groceries, Appliances).
        limit: max deals to return (1-100).

toolsPreview.name: deals_search
toolsPreview.description:
Search in-date SADC products by name or brand (paid, $0.005/req or pass).

    Args:
        q: search term, at least 2 characters (e.g. "airfryer", "iPhone 15", "OMO").
        limit: max results (1-50).

toolsPreview.name: deals_hot
toolsPreview.description:
Biggest absolute price drops among in-date SADC products (paid, $0.001/req or pass).

    Returns products where the retailer listed an old price, sorted by savings.

toolsPreview.name: catalogues
toolsPreview.description:
In-date retailer catalogues from the PriceMate corpus (paid, $0.002/req or pass).

    Args:
        limit: max catalogues to return (1-50).

toolsPreview.name: transcripts_search
toolsPreview.description:
Search 368 episodes of a business/finance podcast corpus (paid, $0.002/req or pass).

    FTS-ranked segments with episode id, date and start time. Ideal for
    research agents that need quoted, dated business-news material.

    Args:
        q: search term, at least 3 characters (e.g. "stablecoin", "agentic payments").
        limit: max results (1-20).

toolsPreview.name: transcripts_context
toolsPreview.description:
Windowed context around a transcript segment (paid, $0.005/req or pass).

    Args:
        episode: episode id from transcripts_search.
        start: segment start time in seconds.

toolsPreview.name: transcripts_episode
toolsPreview.description:
One podcast episode: metadata, segment count, opening (paid, $0.01/req or pass).

    Args:
        episode: episode id from transcripts_search.

toolsPreview.name: transcripts_sentiment
toolsPreview.description:
Lexicon sentiment over top matching segments (paid, $0.002/req or pass).

    Args:
        q: search term.
        limit: max segments scored (1-20).

toolsPreview.name: funding
toolsPreview.description:
Funding/IPO events mined from the podcast corpus (paid, $0.005/req or pass).

    Args:
        limit: max events (1-50).

toolsPreview.name: funding_latest
toolsPreview.description: The single most recent funding/IPO event (paid, $0.002/req or pass).

toolsPreview.name: funding_search
toolsPreview.description:
Funding events by company name (paid, $0.003/req or pass).

    Args:
        company: company name fragment (e.g. "SpaceX", "Ambrook").
        limit: max events (1-20).

toolsPreview.name: agentpay
toolsPreview.description:
Agentic-payments ecosystem brief: x402/MPP/USDC events with episode citations (paid, $0.002/req or pass).

    Args:
        limit: max events (1-50).

toolsPreview.name: agentpay_latest
toolsPreview.description: The single most recent agentic-payments event (paid, $0.001/req or pass).

toolsPreview.name: capex
toolsPreview.description:
AI-capex / model-economy metrics: raises, cloud growth, memory prices, token costs (paid, $0.002/req or pass).

    Args:
        metric: optional metric family filter (e.g. "cloud_growth", "memory_price", "capital_raise").
        limit: max metrics (1-50).

toolsPreview.name: capex_summary
toolsPreview.description: Metric families present in the capex tracker (paid, $0.001/req or pass).

toolsPreview.name: verticals
toolsPreview.description:
Agent-commerce & messy-middle vertical intel: Shopify GMV, Ambrook, super.com datapoints (paid, $0.01/req or pass).

    Args:
        limit: max datapoints (1-50).

toolsPreview.name: verticals_latest
toolsPreview.description: The single most recent vertical-intel datapoint (paid, $0.002/req or pass).

toolsPreview.name: modelwatch
toolsPreview.description:
Model-card watch: launches, silent downgrades, safeguards, policy events by lab (paid, $0.005/req or pass).

    Args:
        limit: max events (1-50).

toolsPreview.name: modelwatch_latest
toolsPreview.description: The most recent model-economy event (paid, $0.002/req or pass).

toolsPreview.name: modelwatch_search
toolsPreview.description:
Model-watch events by lab name (paid, $0.003/req or pass).

    Args:
        lab: lab name fragment (e.g. "Anthropic", "OpenAI", "Meta").
        limit: max events (1-20).

toolsPreview.name: list_categories
toolsPreview.description: Beat/category scoreboard with item counts and latest timestamps (free, no key needed).
